def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one path component: non-empty, no '/' or '\\', not '.' or '..', no NUL."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../a.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("..") == False
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name or "\0" in name:
        return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the directory notes; "" when name is unsafe, missing or unreadable. Never reads outside notes."""
    post is_plain_name(name) or out == ""
    post out == "" or is_plain_name(name)
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    text = ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read(name) else ""
    return text
